manufacturers.name: Northstar Commercial Vehicle
manufacturers.reputation: Conservative Human commercial designs, huge parts availability and few surprises.
manufacturers.design_language: Boxy cab-forward hulls, external service doors and standardized rectangular module bays.
manufacturers.market_position: The fleet-van manufacturer of known space: rarely prestigious, almost always serviceable.

manufacturers.name: Roosevelt Modular Shipworks
manufacturers.reputation: Ships designed to change jobs repeatedly over long working lives.
manufacturers.design_language: Exposed frame rails, bolt-on tanks, interchangeable cargo bodies and obvious retrofit space.
manufacturers.market_position: Favorite of independent operators and small carriers.

manufacturers.name: Kesh Heavy Systems
manufacturers.reputation: Heavy, expensive and notoriously difficult to kill.
manufacturers.design_language: Deep frames, protected machinery, massive gear and redundant plumbing.
manufacturers.market_position: Premium durability; common in dangerous bulk and industrial work.

manufacturers.name: Gateworks Heavy Orbital
manufacturers.reputation: Builds ships that make ordinary freighters look like cargo.
manufacturers.design_language: Long structural spines, detachable container blocks, multiple tug hardpoints and enormous drive sections.
manufacturers.market_position: Dominant in very large bulk commercial construction.

manufacturers.name: Ilyan Vector Works
manufacturers.reputation: Exceptional specific performance with strict maintenance tolerances.
manufacturers.design_language: Compact machinery, skeletal mounts and carefully balanced thrust geometry.
manufacturers.market_position: Premium propulsion found aboard ships from almost every builder.

manufacturers.name: Aerial Massworks
manufacturers.reputation: Makes large volumes weigh surprisingly little; repair requires correct materials and technique.
manufacturers.design_language: Thin trusses, tension structures and minimal exterior cladding.
manufacturers.market_position: Popular with range-focused operators and survey ships.

manufacturers.name: Vey Closed Cycle
manufacturers.reputation: Environmental plants crews trust with their lives.
manufacturers.design_language: Accessible fluid manifolds, redundant treatment loops and conspicuous status windows.
manufacturers.market_position: Near-default environmental supplier on mixed-species long-haul ships.

manufacturers.name: Bluecurrent Marine & Orbital
manufacturers.reputation: Unfashionable anywhere dry and indispensable where there is nowhere dry to land.
manufacturers.design_language: Broad flotation bodies, corrosion-resistant surfaces and high-mounted engines.

manufacturers.name: Orun Thermal Collective
manufacturers.reputation: Repairable, modular thermal equipment with exceptional documentation.
manufacturers.design_language: Dense serviceable assemblies with every valve reachable.
manufacturers.market_position: Common across industrial ships and hot-world operations.

manufacturers.name: Deep Junction Machine Cooperative
manufacturers.reputation: Ugly machinery that mechanics enjoy working on.
manufacturers.design_language: Removable panels, mechanical indicators and standardized service clearances.
